tokens.TITLE: Sample storefront
tokens.SUBTITLE: A first-party demo shop: a card per product, prices, and a checkout summary. Rebuilt from the component map, not scraped from a live site.
tokens.CHECKOUT_BODY: Two items, one shipping line, and a total. The real integration would call the payment provider from a server route; this preview shows the layout the agent planned.
tokens.MAP_INTRO: Every block below is a component the demo identified in the sample storefront, in the order a build would produce them.
tokens.COMPONENT_ROWS: Site headerBrand, nav, cart countStatic markup with an accent ruleProduct cardImage, title, price, add-to-cartOne repeated block in a responsive gridCart summaryLine items, shipping, totalA card with the totals computed in markupFooterContact and legal linksOptional, added by the customisation step
tokens.PLAN_STEPS:
1. Lay out the grid and the accent from the theme token.
  2. Render one card per product from the data block.
  3. Add the cart summary with its totals.
  4. Release the files to the guest hosting site.
